# machine-translated first pass, corrections welcome
# F4Multiplayer texts: العربية (Arabic). The format and the keys are explained in en.txt; keep the {placeholders} as they are.
#
# NOTE: Fallout 4 ships no Arabic font, and its HUD and message boxes (Scaleform) do not shape or reorder right-to-left
# text. With the stock game these texts show as empty boxes or as disconnected, left-to-right letters. They need a font
# mod that adds Arabic to the game's interface (and may still read badly). If Arabic does not display for you, set
# sLanguage = en in F4Multiplayer.ini.
